import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import bootstrap

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/data/requirements_engineering_for_ML-enabled_systems.csv')

# Identify the relevant columns
business_analyst_column = 'Q8_ML_Addressing_Business_Analyst'
developer_column = 'Q8_ML_Addressing_Developer'

# Extract the data for Business Analysts and Developers
business_analyst_data = df[business_analyst_column].dropna()
developer_data = df[developer_column].dropna()

# Define a function to calculate the proportion
def calculate_proportion(data):
    return np.mean(data)

# Perform bootstrapping for Business Analysts
bootstrap_result_business_analyst = bootstrap((business_analyst_data,), calculate_proportion, confidence_level=0.95, random_state=42)

# Perform bootstrapping for Developers
bootstrap_result_developer = bootstrap((developer_data,), calculate_proportion, confidence_level=0.95, random_state=42)

# Get the results
proportion_business_analyst = bootstrap_result_business_analyst.statistic
ci_lower_business_analyst = bootstrap_result_business_analyst.confidence_interval[0]
ci_upper_business_analyst = bootstrap_result_business_analyst.confidence_interval[1]

proportion_developer = bootstrap_result_developer.statistic
ci_lower_developer = bootstrap_result_developer.confidence_interval[0]
ci_upper_developer = bootstrap_result_developer.confidence_interval[1]

proportion_business_analyst, ci_lower_business_analyst, ci_upper_business_analyst, proportion_developer, ci_lower_developer, ci_upper_developer
